identity: The former brewery complex at362FuxingRoadSection3 inSouthDistrict, not the NationalTaiwanMuseumofFineArts or a temple precinct.

officialPages.evidence: Official culture overview and historicindustrial-complexphoto; corroborates venue identity.

officialPhotos.visualInspection: Direct official photo inspected in own Chrome tab. A tall slender silver banded chimney rises between low grayplaster andredbrickfactoryhalls;pitchedgables,palegreenmultipanewindows,lowflatawning andopenbrickpaving dominate.
Additional indexed official plaza photograph:historicindustrialfacades/pipes and opencourtyard. Indexedvisualdescriptiononly,notdirectlyviewed.

distinguishingMotifs: Several low connected industrial buildings of unequal heights, with triangular pitched gables and utilitarian flat connecting roofs.
One tall narrow cylindrical metal chimney, with horizontal rings and a slim ladder/frame, rises well above the roofline.
Alternating warm red-brick and weathered gray-plaster factory walls, rather than a uniformly ornate facade.
Repeated large rectangular multi-pane windows and muted green/seafoam frames; some gables have a round or arched upper opening.
A broad plain paved courtyard and occasional exterior industrial pipework give space around the old factory blocks.
materialColors: Dull silver chimney with gray bands
Muted sage/seafoam windowframes and dark glass
pixelPriorities: Use chimney + staggeredgablefactoryblocks as the dominant silhouette.
Keep brick/window repetition tidy;originalpixelart shouldfeel industrial, not a decorative fantasy museum.
avoid: Brewing smoke/flames to imply an operatingfactory
